thread:
jia: Heads-up: onboarding polyglot-13b-int4 — seeing lateral token id shifts for Cyrillic/Greek tokens after our tokenizer merge. Repro on eval sets: PPL +2.1 on ru/test, en/test stable. :thinking_face:
nate: can you paste the tokenmap diff?
jia: gist: https://gist.redwood/polyglot-tokenmap-diff — key snippet below. Looks like our merge script applied a wrap-around alias when base vocab was smaller, so some unicode codepoints ended up aliased to low ids.
```
# merged.vocab (lines)
3010 0x0410 А
3011 0x0411 Б
3012 0x044F я  # expected 50234 in original polyglot.vocab, got alias -> 3012
3013 0x03B1 α  # greek merged into lower id range
```
sara: @jia can you run a raw logits compare? If embeddings point to wrong rows we'll see consistent semantic drift, not just tokenization artifact.
jia: ran a quick logits diff for 50 RU prompts. Snapshot:
- prompt: "Напиши кратко о климате"
  - baseline (polyglot FP16): top-1 tokens start at: [50234, 120, 9...]
  - merged-int4: top-1 tokens start at: [3012, 120, 9...]  # surreal output, wrong first token -> different continuation
  - PPL: baseline 11.4 -> merged-int4 13.5
nate: wrap-around aliasing would do exactly that. Which conversion flags did you use?
jia: command: 
```
python tools/merge_vocab.py \
  --src polyglot.vocab \
  --base llama.vocab \
  --out merged.vocab \
  --allow-wrap  # <-- currently default in pipeline
```
matt: --allow-wrap is risky for shared vocab. Historically we've used explicit alias-table or --clamp to keep ids in base range. Wrap makes a pseudo-modulo that collides with existing ids.
nate: furthermore, int4 quant compounds this: if embedding matrix rows are reindexed, low-bit packing will scatter wrong entries into the quant blocks, making errors non-linear and larger than fp16 diffs.
jia: quick iter: re-run conversion with --no-wrap and generate an alias table for out-of-range ids. Results: RU PPL back to 11.6 (within noise), token-level alignment > 99%. Will open PR with both options.
deploy-bot: model-conv-bot: conversion job 7769000123 completed (success).
sara: good. Add a regression test in onboarding suite: sample 100 RU/EL prompts, assert delta PPL < 0.3 and top-1 token alignment > 98% between base fp16 and int4 converted variant. Also test that max id after remap <= base_vocab_size.
jia: will add tests + heuristic to fail conversion when any remapped id >= base_vocab_size without an explicit alias table. Also adding a small KV-cache indexing unit test since remap can change token IDs expected by cache.
matt: +1. For production: if conversion fails these checks, router should fallback to llama-compat-13b variant (we have a compatibility variant already). Add default fallback policy in rollout config.
nate: if you want extra GPU cycles for an int4 hyper sweep to sanity-check, ping infra. I'll allocate from dev-pool.
jia: thanks — tagging infra in PR and will drop logs. Short-term mitigation: pin hosted route to previous verified polyglot-13b until patch lands. :thumbsup:
